prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 32 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1351; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment kept growing well beyond what this injury usually needs, with more visits and new services added month after month.
- Objective tests go against the complaints: imaging is normal and the patient moved freely when observed outside the exam room.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and back strain. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported soft tissue findings, and the force of the impact is in keeping with this type of strain. No prior injury to the cervical or lumbar regions is known from the patient's history or available records.

Over the course of care, the patient attended 32 visits. Treatment expanded over successive months, with additional services added beyond what is typically required for a strain of this kind. Imaging of the cervical and lumbar spine was unremarkable. During the clinical course, the patient was observed moving freely outside the examination room, which did not align with the restriction described during formal assessment. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no repeated charges for the same service.

Recommendation: Continue monitoring. Reassess functional limits at the next scheduled visit and consider a formal capacity evaluation if complaints persist.
